title: Interactive Resume Portfolio
description: Professional resume website built with Dash and Python to showcase my education, experience, and data science skills through interactive visualizations and responsive design. Future development planned to migrate to a complete full-stack solution using React, FastAPI, and SQL backend.

title: Brain Tumor MRI Classifier
description: Deep learning model to classify brain tumors from MRI images into four categories: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, or no tumor. Trained on over 7,000 MRI scans as part of university machine learning course.
highlights: Model evaluation with confusion matrix and accuracy metrics

title: Global Water Consumption Dashboard
description: Interactive dashboard for visualizing global water consumption trends by country, year, and sector from 2000-2024. Users can explore total consumption, sector-based usage, per capita trends, and water scarcity levels.
highlights: Interactive filtering by country and year
Deployed on Railway with custom domain

title: Customer Churn Prediction
description: Machine learning pipeline to predict customer churn using Telco dataset. Implements multiple algorithms with GridSearchCV optimization including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and SVM.
highlights: Multiple ML model comparison and evaluation

title: UFO Sightings Dashboard
description: Interactive data visualization dashboard exploring patterns in UFO sightings worldwide. Transforms cluttered tabular data into clear, insightful visuals with map views and temporal analysis for visual storytelling assessment.
highlights: Map visualization of global UFO sightings
Interactive filtering by time, region, and shape
Clear visual storytelling and data transformation
Responsive layout with accessible design choices

title: Diabetes Prevalence Dashboard
description: Interactive dashboard analyzing diabetes prevalence across demographic and health factors using BRFSS 2015 data. Explores patterns by gender, age, education, income, and lifestyle factors with clear visualizations.
highlights: Interactive filtering by age and gender
Clear bar charts and group comparisons
